pr_title: [MER-669] Enable Local Storage to manage new Prebuilt Journeys Banner

comments.body:
Suggestion: 
You probably don't need the separate 
`const [showBanner, setShowBanner] = useState(false);`. 

`useLocalStorage` looks like it can do everything you need, default to true. 

https://git.campmon.com/CMDS/cm-utils/blob/main/packages/use-local-storage/src/index.ts
